therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Bariatric Arterial Embolization with Bead Block particles
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: arterial embolization to reduce gastric blood flow and ghrelin production
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: appetite suppression and weight loss through reduced ghrelin signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: men with prostate adenocarcinoma and morbid obesity starting hormone therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants who experience at least 5 percent weight loss at 6 months

results.dose_information: 300-500µm Bead Block particles for embolization; Lupron 22.5 mg intramuscular or subcutaneous injection every 12 weeks

context.duration: 6 months primary endpoint, follow-up to 48 weeks
